stemMarkdown: A rectangular garden 20 m by 15 m is surrounded by a path 2 m wide running all around it on the outside. Find the area (in square m) of the path.
solutionMarkdown: The outer rectangle measures $24$ m by $19$ m, an area of $456$ square m. Subtracting the garden's $300$ square m leaves $156$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The path widens the plot on both sides, so each dimension grows by twice the width.
